reason: Design challenge complete. Verified all repo-relative Sources citations in docs/13/SPEC.md against baseline 44ad7cc4d6af7a30cde2b139d9ad25c19b41c2bf (confirmed as current HEAD). Nearly all citations are accurate. Found two genuine conflicts between SPEC narrative/Files-to-Change claims and actual repo content: (1) SPEC section 5 asserts commands/nightshift-implement.md:244-246 'passes `--task \"$TASK\"`' as an existing fact, but nightshift-agent.sh has no --task flag at all in its current argument parser (verified full option list) and the cited lines pass only --gear/--auth/--risk/--attempt/--in/--out — this callsite does not thread a task ID today, contradicting the asymmetric framing versus trajectory.py 'must establish'. (2) Files-to-Change marks tests/test-behavior-proof.sh '[NEW] TEST', but the file already exists and is git-tracked at the cited baseline (git status showed only '?? docs/13/' untracked), and it is already swept into CI via `.github/workflows/shellcheck.yml`'s `for test_script in tests/test-*.sh` loop — so it is live, wired-in, pre-existing test content, not a new artifact to create. All NET_NEW proposed identifiers (scripts/nightshift-behavior-proof.py, agents/nightshift-behavior-reviewer.md, contracts/nightshift-behavior-reviewer.schema.json, docs/BEHAVIOR-PROOF.md, docs/13/behavior-scenarios.json) were confirmed absent as expected/declared. Issue #18/#19 boundaries (install-inventory single-owner mapping, legacy project-context.py explicit mapping, branding-policy.json exception schema) remain intact and are correctly respected by the proposed changes. No execution of providers/prototypes/installations/Coach was performed; sandbox also blocked most script execution (approval-gated), so verification was static (grep/read) only — dynamic RED-status of test-behavior-proof.sh against current baseline was not executed, only its pre-existing tracked presence and CI wiring were confirmed.
